map.毛利和净利区别？: What Is the Difference Between Gross Profit and Net Profit?
map.毛利扣直接成本，净利再扣税费与摊折；本工具算到毛利级，净利以财务账为准。结果仅供: Gross profit deducts direct cost, and net profit further deducts taxes and amortisation; this tool computes up to the gross profit level, while net profit follows the financial accounts. The results are only for e-commerce operations estimates, product selection, and decision reference; they do not constitute financial or tax advice and do not replace the latest platform rules or formal reconciliation, so the official platform rules and the actual books govern.

map.费用结构：录入推广/佣金/物流占比，看费用是否吃掉利润。: Expense structure: enter the share of promotion, commission, and logistics to see whether the expenses eat up the profit.
